description: A utility class providing static methods for directory operations such as checking existence in include_path, fixing directory strings for OS compatibility, retrieving parent directories, and managing temporary directory paths.

classes.name: Solar_Dir
classes.description: A utility class for static directory-related methods, including checking directory existence in include_path, fixing directory strings, navigating directory hierarchy, and handling OS-specific temporary directories.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists in the include_path or as an absolute/relative path, returning the absolute path if found, false otherwise.

methods.name: fix
methods.description: Converts directory string slashes to OS-specific separators and ensures a trailing separator.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the directory name of a given file, optionally moving up in the directory hierarchy.

methods.name: tmp
methods.description: Returns the OS-specific temporary directory path, optionally appending a subdirectory.

methods.name: _tmp
methods.description: Internal method to determine the system's temporary directory path based on OS.
